item.meaning: The foundational body of direct rural democracy consisting of all registered adult voters in a village.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.definition: The three-tier system of local self-government in rural India operating at village, block, and district levels.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.title: Bottom-Up Rural Decentralization
item.explanation: Panchayati Raj delegates power to local villagers through the Gram Sabha, ensuring direct democratic participation and responsive development.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.name: Gram Panchayat
item.function: The executive council at the village level directly elected by the Gram Sabha to handle local administration, sanitation, and roads.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.name: Panchayat Samiti
item.function: The block-level Panchayati Raj institution coordinating development programs across multiple neighboring Gram Panchayats.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.name: Zila Parishad
item.function: The top-tier Panchayati Raj body managing district-wide development plans, state grants, and inter-block coordination.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.description: The decentralized rural local self-governance system consisting of Gram Panchayat (village), Panchayat Samiti (block), and Zila Parishad (district).
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)

item.category: The Three Tiers of Panchayati Raj
items: 1. Gram Panchayat (Base Tier): Village-level elected council headed by a Sarpanch.
2. Panchayat Samiti (Middle Tier): Block-level council coordinating multiple Gram Panchayats.
3. Zila Parishad (Apex Tier): District-level council overseeing regional development.
item.source_context: Chapter 11: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas) (fees111.pdf)
